message: You know that feeling when you realize you’ve been living in the land of “it’ll never happen to me”? 🤦‍♀️ Well, I recently stumbled upon some solid tips on how to tackle home fires. It’s like a comedic reminder that being prepared is actually a smart move, not just a checklist of doom. So, let’s all take a moment to laugh at our past selves and get a bit more ready for whatever comes our way—because a little prep can go a long way in keeping our homes cozy and safe!
